$comment: Example consumer config exercising every kind this repo ships. Use it as a starting point for your own .checkly/checks.json. The $schema reference above gives you autocomplete + inline validation in VS Code.

project.$comment: One config file = one Checkly project. `logicalId` is the stable slug Checkly stores against; renaming it is destructive.
project.name: Acme - Corporate Website

defaults.$comment: Project-level defaults inherited by every entry. Entries can still override per-check via their own `env` / `frequency` / `locations` fields.

checks.$comment: Bread-and-butter uptime + SSL probe for the public homepage. Inherits env=PROD and the project default frequency/locations.
Apex-domain redirect check: http://acme.com must 301 to https://www.acme.com/. Smoke-only — release gate, not a continuous monitor.

ASP.NET Core health-checks endpoint. `X-Health-Key` is sourced from a CI secret env var (HEALTH_KEY) — see src/checks/dotnet-health/README.md for the pipeline wiring. Overrides project frequency to a tighter 5m.
Static-HTML content assertion: the marketing homepage must have the expected <title> and must not contain placeholder copy.

SPA content assertion via Playwright. Use this (not `xpath`) when the markup is client-rendered. Custom name override demonstrates the entry-level `name` field — when set, it wins over the auto-composed `{codename} - {env} - {kind} - {url}`.
checks.name: App headline + error banner check (PROD)

checks.$comment: GDPR compliance probe: targeted (in-region) mode against the EU-UK-CA preset, plus a custom tracking domain the preset doesn't know about. Pinned to eu-central-1 so the page sees a restricted-region IP.
Pre-launch smoke gate: every page-level SEO / a11y / hygiene rule we care about in one Playwright check. Daily cadence is fine because this primarily runs in the release pipeline.
